title: CandidateUpdate
description: A proposed change to a role-owned document, held in a separate area until the owning role adopts it. Adoption re-validates the baseline: a candidate whose baseline revision no longer matches the document's current revision is rejected with REVISION_CONFLICT. Candidates never merge consultation-branch history automatically.

target_role_id.description: Owner role of the target document.

baseline_revision.description: Document revision the proposal was made against; re-checked at adoption time.

proposed_body_hash.description: SHA-256 of the proposed body, stored content-addressed outside this record.

source.description: knowledge.import candidates carry the exported revision as their baseline.

state.description: adopted: published by the owner; superseded: baseline passed over; rejected: explicitly declined.

resolved_at.description: Required once the candidate leaves the open state.
